RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-male panel is worth noting as a process concern, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your stronger academic credentials justify asking how the published criteria were applied; industry experience might legitimately matter.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and any applicable panel-composition policy. Raise the panel’s composition neutrally alongside these questions, rather than as proof of discrimination.

If a completed PhD was essential, ask specifically how the appointee satisfied that requirement. Check local complaint deadlines promptly with your union or an equality adviser; waiting for a response may not pause them.
